title: An integral counterexample to Gersten's conjecture
summary: We construct a two-dimensional ramified regular local ring A of mixed characteristic $`(0,5)`$ for which $`K_5(A)\to K_5(\mathop{\mathrm{Frac}}\nolimits A)`$ has a nonzero kernel. This disproves Gersten's conjecture in its unrestricted integral form.

review.reason: Constructs a mixed-characteristic local ring disproving an integral form of Gersten's conjecture.
